parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockDeviceContext` located at `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/Mocks/MockDeviceContext.swift`, which is a test-fixture mock of the production `DeviceContext` type at `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/DeviceContext.swift`. The subset-pair relationship between a mock and its production counterpart is intentional by design: the mock deliberately mirrors a subset of the production type's surface to satisfy test-double semantics. Lifting shared shape into common code would couple production throttling logic to test infrastructure, which is the canonical restraint pattern. No refactor is warranted.
